version: 1.3.13

cache: false

# Managed GitHub Skill Sync. The source id remains stable across promotion;
# production follows server/synology.
skillSync:
  github:
    enabled: true
    intervalMinutes: 5
    runOnStartup: true
    sources:
      - id: managed-skills
        owner: justinthenick
        repo: LibreChat
        ref: server/synology
        paths:
          - managed-skills/skills
        credentialKey: github-skills-prod

interface:
  customWelcome: 'LibreChat on Synology'
  modelSelect: true
  parameters: true
  presets: true
  webSearch: true
  runCode: true
  memories: true
  prompts:
    use: true
    create: true
    share: false
    public: false
  bookmarks: true
  multiConvo: true
  agents:
    use: true
    create: true
    share: false
    public: false
  schedules:
    use: true
    create: true
    maxPerUser: 10
    minIntervalMinutes: 60
    autoDisableAfterFailures: 5
    fireConcurrency: 1
  mcpServers:
    use: true
    create: false
    share: false
    public: false
  fileSearch: false
  marketplace:
    use: false

# Memory is enabled globally. In the deployed LibreChat build, `memory` is not
# a valid endpoints.agents.capabilities enum value, so it must not be listed
# there. Agent-level memory isolation remains a manifest concern for production
# agents rather than an endpoint capability token.
memory:
  disabled: false

# Tavily is the initial managed web-search backend. LibreChat's supported page-
# fetch/extraction path is the web_search scraper provider rather than a separate
# web_fetch Agent capability/tool in this checkout.
webSearch:
  searchProvider: tavily
  scraperProvider: tavily
  rerankerType: none
  tavilyApiKey: '${TAVILY_API_KEY}'

# OCR is an Agent endpoint capability with its own top-level runtime service
# configuration. The Mistral OCR strategy becomes operational when the managed
# OCR service credential/base URL are configured in Admin Settings.
ocr:
  apiKey: '${OCR_API_KEY}'
  baseURL: '${OCR_BASEURL}'
  strategy: mistral_ocr

# Permit only the reviewed WSL coding executor through the MCP private-address
# guard. The bearer token is supplied from the private managed .env and is never
# stored in this reviewed configuration.
mcpSettings:
  allowedAddresses:
    - '${CODING_EXECUTOR_HOST}:${CODING_EXECUTOR_PORT}'

mcpServers:
  coding_executor:
    type: streamable-http
    url: 'http://${CODING_EXECUTOR_HOST}:${CODING_EXECUTOR_PORT}/mcp'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer ${CODING_EXECUTOR_TOKEN}'
    requiresOAuth: false
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    timeout: 300000

  # Solution-architecture evidence source. GitHub's remote MCP server enforces
  # read-only mode server-side. The fine-grained PAT is user-scoped in LibreChat
  # rather than placed in the NAS process environment or committed configuration.
  github_readonly:
    type: streamable-http
    url: 'https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/'
    headers:
      Authorization: 'Bearer {{GITHUB_ARCHITECT_PAT}}'
      X-MCP-Readonly: 'true'
      X-MCP-Toolsets: 'repos'
    customUserVars:
      GITHUB_ARCHITECT_PAT:
        title: 'GitHub read-only PAT'
        description: 'Fine-grained token scoped to the LibreChat repository with read-only permissions.'
        sensitive: true
    requiresOAuth: false
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    startup: false
    timeout: 120000

  # Curated view of deployment configuration for architecture/assurance agents.
  # Every source file is bind-mounted read-only in docker-compose.yml; the real
  # private .env, credentials, Docker socket and arbitrary NAS filesystem are not
  # exposed. Disable all write-capable filesystem tools when assigning this MCP
  # to an Agent; the read-only bind mounts remain the hard enforcement boundary.
  architecture_files:
    type: stdio
    command: npx
    args:
      - -y
      - '@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2026.1.14'
      - /architecture-view
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    startup: false
    timeout: 120000

  # Live host/runtime evidence source. The stdio bridge has no Docker socket and
  # can reach only a group-restricted Unix socket served by the host worker. The
  # worker itself exposes a fixed read-only action allowlist and sanitizes Docker
  # inspection data before returning it to the Agent.
  nas_infra_readonly:
    type: stdio
    command: python3
    args:
      - /app/nas-infra-readonly-mcp.py
    chatMenu: false
    serverInstructions: true
    startup: false
    timeout: 120000

endpoints:
  # Pin only capability enum values accepted by the deployed LibreChat build.
  # Unsupported pseudo-capabilities such as memory, run_in_background and
  # ask_user_question must not be advertised here because schema validation is
  # fatal and prevents the API from starting.
  agents:
    capabilities:
      - deferred_tools
      - file_search
      - execute_code
      - web_search
      - actions
      - ocr
      - artifacts
      - subagents
      - context
      - skills
      - tools
      - chain
    skills:
      maxCatalogSkills: 100

  custom:
    - name: 'OpenRouter'
      apiKey: '${OPENROUTER_KEY}'
      baseURL: 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'
      # BEGIN MANAGED OPENROUTER MODELS
      # render-librechat-config.py replaces only this block in the runtime copy.
      # With no managed allowlist, keep the historical default and fetch the
      # complete provider catalogue.
      models:
        default:
          - 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2'
        fetch: true
      # END MANAGED OPENROUTER MODELS
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2'
      summarize: false
      forcePrompt: false
      modelDisplayLabel: 'OpenRouter'

recipe_name: MSA-001 post-merge NAS deployment and skill-sync verification
